view: three-quarter, facing right (mirror for facing left)
pivot: feet centre, 4 px above the cell bottom (window variants: centre of the sill cut edge)

blink.note: only while the still idle is shown (the video idle blinks by itself)

gesture.note: PlayGesture: hold, then return to idle (no in-betweens)

switching: Start talking only at a video idle loop boundary (cell 0 matches the still idle pose) or cross-fade ~80 ms; video cells are slightly softer than the edit-based stills.
notes: S03. Standing (the art_brief says she sits; see ISSUES ART-NPC-01). Magenta key (green vest). idle = calm ping-pong of a Hailuo clip (head turns toward the road and back); idle_checklist = optional fidget (she checks her clipboard), play it now and then instead of one idle cycle.
